notes: The story now always knows who is with you. Every reply ends with exactly who's still there, so when you go off on a date with one person, the others stay behind and go back to their own day.
Side panel: anyone with you has a Leave them button (and people nearby have Bring along) so you can fix it yourself.
Plans you make by invite are private: other characters don't know about your date unless someone tells them.

Trust starts at a neutral 25 (stranger) instead of 0, shows a word like acquaintance or friendly next to the number, and moves more often when what you do matters to someone. Old stories stuck at 0 across the board are moved to 25.
